It is not ANECA-verified, not in RUCT, not in MECES, not inside the EHEA/Bologna second cycle, carries no Diploma Supplement as of right and grants no access to doctoral study. It carries 60 ECTS and may be respected by employers, but there is NO automatic academic recognition in another European country: recognition is entirely at the discretion of the receiving institution or employer, case by case. It is also ineligible for the public scholarship routes that require an official título. Two further cautions: (i) even a genuinely official Spanish máster universitario would give ACADEMIC recognition inside the EHEA, not PROFESSIONAL recognition for a regulated profession (that runs through Directive 2005/36/EC and a separate national process), and would still need the receiving country's own procedure — the EHEA makes it routine, not automatic; (ii) this programme is NOT in that category at all, so neither applies to it. WARNING ON MARKETING: the page's exam-supervision paragraph contains the phrase 'te permitirá conseguir tu título con total protección, aportando garantía, seguridad, y con la oficialidad que otorga ANECA'. That sentence describes UNIE's anti-fraud proctoring system, not this certificate; this título propio has no ANECA verification and the phrase must not be read as a claim of officiality for it

notes: HARD BLOCKER FOR THIS CANDIDATE — ENTRY REQUIREMENTS. The page's 'Requisitos de acceso' section states: 'Para poder acceder a este Máster en Composición Musical online es necesario que los estudiantes procedan de titulaciones con una relación directa con la música. Podrán matricularse aquellos que cuenten con: Grado en Música. Grado en Musicología. Grado en Historia y Ciencias de la Música. Título Superior de Música de Conservatorio en cualquier especialidad.' The only alternative route is 'experiencia profesional demostrable, de al menos dos años, ejerciendo como profesor de Música en conservatorios o instituciones educativas o director o instrumentista en orquestas de carácter nacional o autonómico'. A 300-ECTS software-engineering degree does NOT satisfy the degree list, and a working producer/DJ does not satisfy the alternative route as written (it names conservatory/institutional music teaching, or conducting or playing in a national/regional orchestra — not production or DJing). Unlike the Enseñanzas Artísticas register, where art. 15 RD 1614/2009 admits the holder of ANY official Grado and the real gate is a portfolio-based prueba de acceso, this is a university máster universitario whose own memoria sets a closed music-degree admission profile. Treat this programme as very likely closed to this candidate unless UNIR's admission committee accepts an equivalence, which is not evidenced anywhere on the page. 300-ECTS QUESTION: the memoria section 4.6 states 'No se exigen complementos formativos para este máster', and RUCT publishes ects_complementos_formativos as null (NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT) rather than 0 — so no title-level bridging exists, but that is moot given the admission profile above. UNIR does operate a credit-recognition system for this title (published criteria document DO-2.2-3.2 Criterios_Reconocimiento_MU_Composicion_Musical, 11/01/2023). STRUCTURE: 60 ECTS, 1 curso, of which 48 obligatorios and 12 TFM, 0 optativos and 0 prácticas (RUCT). The TFM is performative: the student's own compositions become a professional portfolio, and the five best students of each cohort get a commissioned work premiered at the Real Academia de Bellas Artes de San Fernando. Practical workshops use EastWest ComposerCloud, Reaper, Max/MSP, Kontakt. Rama de conocimiento: Artes y Humanidades. autonomous_community: Castilla y León (seat of the awarding university; the programme is taught 100% online, not at a campus)
campus: No teaching campus — 'Modalidad: Online'. Awarding seat: Campus Burgos, Calle Fernán González 76, 09003 Burgos, in the historic centre of the city, where UI1 concentrates its five faculties (this title sits under the Facultad de Ciencias y Tecnología). Tel (+34) 947 671 731, info@ui1.es
university_awarding: Universidad Internacional Isabel I de Castilla — private online university. Corporate entity 'Universidad Internacional Isabel I De Castilla S.A.U.', listed on UI1's own consent notice among the 'Empresas del Grupo iLERNA' alongside Ilerna Online S.L.U., Grupo Campus Educativo S.A.U. and others, so the university is part of the iLERNA education group. UI1 awards this certificate in its own name, but as an entry in its 'MBA y Posgrados' catalogue it is a título propio, not an official degree
official_status: título propio — THE INPUT'S PRIOR ('máster universitario') IS WRONG AND IS CORRECTED HERE. Four independent pieces of evidence, all from UI1's own site: (1) the programme's name is 'Máster en Ingeniería Informática e Inteligencia Artificial', WITHOUT the words 'Máster Universitario'; (2) the breadcrumb on every one of its pages reads 'Inicio › Oferta académica › Posgrados › Máster en Ingeniería Informática e Inteligencia Artificial'; (3) UI1's own catalogue splits 'Másteres Oficiales' from 'MBA y Posgrados' as two separate menu items, and this title is listed ONLY under MBA y Posgrados, whose own introduction says 'En la Universidad Isabel I ofrecemos diferentes títulos propios, MBA y posgrados'. It is ABSENT from /oferta-academica/masteres-universitarios-oficiales, whose Ciencias y Tecnología section lists only Análisis Inteligente de Datos Masivos (Big Data), Ciberseguridad and Divulgación Científica; (4) RUCT holds exactly two Isabel I titles in these fields — 4316337 Análisis Inteligente de Datos Masivos and 4316346 Ciberseguridad — matching that official list, and a direct RUCT query by university ('Isabel I') and by term ('informatica', 'ingenieria informatica') returns no informatics master at this university at all
ruct_code: NONE — not in RUCT, and correctly so: a título propio cannot have a RUCT code. Verified by direct query (.masters-search/spain/ruct.py --universidad 'Isabel I' returns 0 rows; term queries 'informatica' and 'ingenieria informatica' return no Isabel I row), and by the backbone, which holds only 4316337 and 4316346 for this university in the nine fields
boe_order: NOT APPLICABLE — a título propio is not declared official by Council of Ministers agreement and has no BOE publication. This is also not an Enseñanzas Artísticas title, so no BOE homologation order applies either
europe_recognition: NOT RECOGNISED AS AN OFFICIAL DEGREE ANYWHERE IN EUROPE, SPAIN INCLUDED. This is a título propio (UI1's own postgraduate certificate). It is not ANECA-verified, not in RUCT, not in MECES, not inside the EHEA/Bologna second cycle, carries no Diploma Supplement as of right, and gives NO access to doctoral study. It carries 60 ECTS on UI1's own syllabus table, but ECTS on a título propio are the university's own credit accounting and do not by themselves confer framework recognition. There is NO automatic academic recognition in another European country: recognition rests entirely with the receiving institution or employer, decided case by case. It is likewise outside the public scholarship routes that require an official título. Two standard cautions, recorded for completeness and neither of which helps this title: EHEA academic recognition is not professional recognition for a regulated profession (Directive 2005/36/EC and a separate national process), and even a genuinely official Spanish máster still needs the receiving country's own procedure abroad. Neither applies here because this qualification is not in the EHEA framework at all. NOTE FOR THE CANDIDATE: UI1 DOES run official másteres universitarios in adjacent fields — Análisis Inteligente de Datos Masivos (Big Data), RUCT 4316337, and Ciberseguridad, RUCT 4316346, both 'Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA)' — and those, unlike this one, would be EHEA level 7. If UI1 is attractive, those are the titles to look at
tuition_eu_eur: NOT FOUND — UI1 publishes no price for this programme. No figure has been estimated
tuition_non_eu_eur: NOT FOUND — no fee of any kind is published, so no non-EU differential could be checked. Page silence is NOT evidence of 'no surcharge'. As a private online university UI1 would ordinarily charge one flat rate regardless of nationality, but that is a general expectation and is NOT sourced for this programme
tuition_year_of_rates: NOT FOUND — no rates published, hence no rate year
fees_extra_eur: EUR 0 for two specific items, positively sourced: UI1's 'Descuentos y financiación' page lists under 'Incluido en el precio' — 'Tasas de apertura de expediente / matrícula gratuita' (no file-opening or enrolment fee), 'Carnet de Estudiante Digital gratuito', and 'Todo el material incluido' (study materials included, no separate charge). Payment of the matrícula may be split into 3, 6, 9 or 12 monthly instalments via SeQura, and UI1 signposts loans through Caja Rural de Soria and Banco Santander, with the explicit disclaimer that the university has no role in granting them. No other charge is published, so any further extras are NOT FOUND

language_of_instruction: NOT FOUND as an explicit statement — the programme page carries no 'Idioma' / 'Idioma de impartición' field, unlike UNIE's and UNIR's pages. All programme content is published in Spanish only (programme description, all eleven subject titles in the Programa académico table, admission page), and UI1 is a Spanish-language online university, so Spanish is the strong working assumption — but per the sweep's rule 7 an inference is not a statement, and no explicit declaration was located. Recorded as NOT FOUND rather than asserted. No language certificate requirement is published either
start_month: January and April (plus September) — CONFIRMED from the programme page's own intake strip, which reads 'INICIO: Sept. - En. - Abr.' Three cohorts a year, two of them in the spring half. CAVEAT, and it matters: the same strip currently displays 'Matrícula cerrada' (enrolment closed) at the time of access, so intakes exist on paper but the enrolment window was shut when this record was made. No specific 2027 dates are published
notes: THE HEADLINE CORRECTION FOR THIS ROW: the input carried official_status_prior 'máster universitario (UI1 official online master's catalogue)'. That is wrong. UI1's catalogue does have an 'official online master's' section, but this programme is not in it — it is in the neighbouring 'MBA y Posgrados' (títulos propios) section. The confusion is easy to make because UI1 names its títulos propios 'Máster en X' with no 'Universitario', places them at /oferta-academica/master-... URLs identical in shape to the official ones, and lists them a click away in the same nav. Siblings in the same título-propio family: Máster en Ingeniería Informática, Máster en Ingeniería Informática y Big Data, Máster en Ingeniería Informática y Ciberseguridad, MBA en Big Data y Analytics, MBA en Ciberseguridad, and a 'Programa Universitario en Inteligencia Artificial para la Industria Conectada'. STRUCTURE: 60 ECTS over three trimesters, 11 subjects, no TFM and no prácticas listed on the syllabus table — Trimestre 1: Dirección de proyectos TIC 6, Auditoría y Calidad de los Sistemas Informáticos 6, Desarrollo de Inteligencia artificial avanzada 6; Trimestre 2: Servicios y Aplicaciones Web 6, Tecnología y desarrollo en dispositivos móviles 6, Sistemas de gestión de seguridad de la información 6, Análisis Inteligente de Datos 3; Trimestre 3: Machine Learning e Inteligencia Artificial 6, Redes Neuronales y Aprendizaje Profundo 6, Modelos de IA Generativa 6, Desarrollo de Aplicaciones IA 3. Total printed as 60. ACCESS FOR THIS CANDIDATE: the entry rule is a RECOMMENDATION, not a requirement — 'se recomienda estar en posesión de un título universitario español u otro expedido por una institución de educación superior del Espacio Europeo de Educación Superior' in Ingeniería Informática, Matemáticas, Telecomunicaciones, Sistemas de Información, Ingeniería de Software, Electrónica, Estadística, Física, Automatización y Control, or related areas; and 'En caso de no contar con una titulación universitaria, se valorará la experiencia laboral'. The candidate's software-engineering degree is squarely inside the named list, but note the wording says EHEA institutions and adds 'Si dispones de un título extranjero, consulta con tu orientador' — a Tunisian degree is outside the EHEA and would go through the adviser route. 300-ECTS QUESTION: a título propio has no complementos-de-formación machinery, so there is nothing to be exempted from; UI1 does publish a general 'Reconocimiento de créditos' page, but no title-level credit-recognition rule for this programme was found. THE STRATEGIC POINT: for a candidate whose priorities are funding eligibility and European recognition, this programme fails on both counts while UI1's own official Big Data and Ciberseguridad másteres universitarios do not.
